fixtures.name: Fixed-lattice gap promoted to continuum physical mass gap
fixtures.invalid_inference: A positive transfer-matrix or correlation gap at one lattice spacing proves the Clay mass gap.
fixtures.missing_obligation: No cutoff-uniform lower bound in fixed physical units, continuum convergence, or spectral-stability theorem is supplied.
fixtures.witness: A dimensionless gap can be positive for every regulator value while its physical normalization tends to zero as the lattice spacing tends to zero.
fixtures.remediation: State the transfer normalization, prove volume- and cutoff-uniform physical bounds, reconstruct the limiting Hamiltonian, and prove that spectral exclusion survives the limit.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not weaken fixed-regulator lattice gap theorems or their use as inputs to a future continuum argument.

fixtures.name: Finite-volume discreteness promoted to an infinite-volume gap
fixtures.invalid_inference: The first excited energy in every finite box is positive, therefore the infinite-volume theory has a mass gap.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Finite-volume spectral discreteness is generic; no lower bound uniform in volume or thermodynamic spectral convergence is proved.
fixtures.witness: A sequence of positive finite-volume gaps may decrease to zero as the volume grows.
fixtures.remediation: Prove a volume-independent lower bound in compatible physical units and a limit theorem preserving the excluded spectral interval.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not rule out finite-volume Hamiltonians as regulated approximations.

fixtures.name: Strong-coupling lattice phase identified with the continuum target
fixtures.invalid_inference: A rigorous strong-coupling cluster expansion or lattice mass gap establishes four-dimensional continuum Yang-Mills.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The physical continuum limit is approached along a weak-bare-coupling critical trajectory; no bridge from the proved strong-coupling region is given.
fixtures.witness: Analytic control on one open coupling region need not extend across a phase boundary or to a critical scaling limit.
fixtures.remediation: Supply a controlled path to the continuum scaling regime with uniform estimates and identification of the limiting theory.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not diminish rigorous strong-coupling existence, confinement, or decay results within their stated regime.

fixtures.name: Confinement or area law substituted for the spectral mass gap
fixtures.invalid_inference: A Wilson-loop area law or confinement statement is identical to the Clay mass-gap theorem.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Confinement observables and the spectrum of the reconstructed physical Hamiltonian are distinct objects; no theorem identifies them under the candidate hypotheses.
fixtures.witness: The official problem treats confinement and mass gap as related but separate objectives.
fixtures.remediation: State the precise confinement notion and prove an implication to the required physical spectral exclusion, including reconstruction and observable completeness.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not rule out confinement as an important consequence or auxiliary mechanism.

fixtures.name: Decay in one correlator promoted to the full physical gap
fixtures.invalid_inference: Exponential decay of one selected Euclidean correlator proves a gap above the vacuum in the full physical Hilbert space.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The selected observable may fail to couple to the lowest excitation; reconstruction, positivity, and a separating observable class are not established.
fixtures.witness: An operator orthogonal to low-energy states can have faster decay than the true spectral bottom.
fixtures.remediation: Prove OS reconstruction and a converse spectral theorem for a dense or separating physical observable class with uniform decay control.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not invalidate channel-specific inverse correlation lengths.

fixtures.name: Reflection positivity treated as the complete constructive theory
fixtures.invalid_inference: Reflection positivity of a regulated lattice measure by itself constructs the required four-dimensional quantum field theory.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Regulator removal, Euclidean regularity, covariance, clustering or vacuum control, local observables, nontriviality, and reconstruction hypotheses remain open.
fixtures.witness: One Osterwalder-Schrader axiom does not imply the full OS profile.
fixtures.remediation: Verify the complete limiting Schwinger-function axiom profile and apply a reconstruction theorem with all hypotheses explicit.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not reduce the importance of reflection positivity in a constructive route.

fixtures.name: Regulated transfer matrix identified with the physical Hamiltonian
fixtures.invalid_inference: A positive self-adjoint lattice transfer matrix immediately supplies the Hamiltonian required by the Clay statement.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The operator belongs to a regulated theory; its continuum domain, generator convergence, gauge-invariant physical sector, and spectral normalization are not identified.
fixtures.witness: Operator convergence and spectral convergence require hypotheses not supplied by positivity alone.
fixtures.remediation: Construct the limiting physical Hilbert space and generator and prove convergence adequate to preserve the claimed spectral information.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not challenge the regulated transfer-matrix construction.

fixtures.name: Perturbative asymptotic freedom promoted to nonperturbative existence
fixtures.invalid_inference: The negative beta function and perturbative renormalizability construct the full interacting continuum theory.
fixtures.missing_obligation: An asymptotic expansion does not define a global nonperturbative measure or operator theory, prove OS axioms, or establish an infrared gap.
fixtures.witness: Formal or asymptotic series may exist without a corresponding nonperturbative object established by the argument.
fixtures.remediation: Provide a regulator construction, nonperturbative limit, axiomatic identification, and independent infrared spectral proof.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not weaken asymptotic freedom as a required ultraviolet concordance condition.

fixtures.name: Lower-dimensional construction transferred to four dimensions
fixtures.invalid_inference: A rigorous two- or three-dimensional Yang-Mills construction proves the four-dimensional problem by analogy.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Renormalization, scaling, ultraviolet divergences, field regularity, and criticality change with dimension; no dimension-raising theorem is supplied.
fixtures.witness: Superrenormalizable and exactly tractable lower-dimensional models need not share the four-dimensional continuum obstruction.
fixtures.remediation: Use lower-dimensional results only as typed analogues unless an exact reduction or transfer theorem is proved.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not diminish lower-dimensional models as laboratories for definitions and techniques.

fixtures.name: Abelian theory substituted for compact simple non-Abelian Yang-Mills
fixtures.invalid_inference: A construction or gap result for U(1) establishes the universally quantified compact-simple non-Abelian target.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The gauge group, self-interaction, beta function, and confinement structure differ; U(1) is not compact simple in the required sense.
fixtures.witness: Changing the structure group changes the theory rather than specializing the official quantifier.
fixtures.remediation: Treat Abelian results as analogues or prove a valid reduction covering every compact simple group.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not rule out Abelian constructions as comparison models.

fixtures.name: Large-N limit promoted to every finite compact simple group
fixtures.invalid_inference: An exact or asymptotic large-N solution proves the Clay statement for finite N and every compact simple G.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Interchange of N with volume and continuum limits, finite-N error control, and coverage of other group families are absent.
fixtures.witness: A limiting sequence can have properties not shared uniformly by any finite member.
fixtures.remediation: Prove uniform finite-N estimates, limit interchange, and a reduction covering the official group quantifier.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not reduce the value of large-N theorems within their stated limit.

fixtures.name: Gauge-fixed auxiliary fields treated as a positive physical theory
fixtures.invalid_inference: A gauge-fixed or BRST-formal construction in an indefinite state space already satisfies the physical Hilbert-space axioms.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Physical positivity, gauge-invariant observables, quotient/cohomology control, locality, and the self-adjoint physical Hamiltonian are not recovered.
fixtures.witness: Auxiliary gauge-dependent fields need not act on a positive-definite physical Hilbert space.
fixtures.remediation: Construct and identify the gauge-invariant positive physical sector and prove the axioms there.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not prohibit gauge fixing as an intermediate analytic device.

fixtures.name: Formal path integral or finite partition function treated as existence
fixtures.invalid_inference: Writing the Yang-Mills path integral, or proving a finite regulated partition function, constructs the continuum local quantum field theory.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Measure existence after renormalization, regulator limits, local-field construction, positivity, nontriviality, and reconstruction are not proved.
fixtures.witness: A formal integral can encode perturbation theory without defining a countably additive continuum measure.
fixtures.remediation: Specify the regulated object and prove convergence to a limiting Schwinger hierarchy satisfying the accepted axiomatic profile.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not invalidate regulated partition functions as ingredients.

fixtures.name: Unidentified subsequential limit promoted to the target theory
fixtures.invalid_inference: Tightness or compactness yielding some weak subsequential limit establishes quantum Yang-Mills.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Uniqueness, regulator independence, gauge-observable identification, nontriviality, axioms, UV concordance, and mass gap are not established.
fixtures.witness: Different subsequences may converge to inequivalent or degenerate limits.
fixtures.remediation: Identify the limit, prove the required axioms and nontriviality, and establish universality or controlled dependence on the regulator.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not rule out compactness as one step in a constructive proof.

fixtures.name: Classical Yang-Mills PDE existence substituted for quantum existence
fixtures.invalid_inference: Global well-posedness or regularity of the classical Yang-Mills equations solves the quantum existence and mass-gap problem.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Quantization, renormalization, local quantum observables, Hilbert-space reconstruction, and quantum spectral analysis are absent.
fixtures.witness: Classical flow properties do not define quantum correlation functions or a quantum Hamiltonian spectrum.
fixtures.remediation: Keep classical PDE results as auxiliary estimates unless a rigorous quantization bridge is proved.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not diminish classical estimates that may support a constructive route.

fixtures.name: Numerical glueball spectrum promoted to theorem-grade mass gap
fixtures.invalid_inference: Monte Carlo estimates of a positive glueball mass prove the exact continuum mass gap.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Statistical, discretization, finite-volume, scale-setting, continuum-extrapolation, and complete-spectrum errors are not certified as a proof.
fixtures.witness: A positive numerical estimate with error bars does not exclude an unobserved lower state or a vanishing exact limit.
fixtures.remediation: Classify numerical output as evidence only, with certified errors and a theorem linking it to the complete physical spectrum if used in a proof.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not diminish numerical spectroscopy as physical evidence or a diagnostic.

fixtures.name: A recent complete-solution claim accepted by title or abstract
fixtures.invalid_inference: A preprint claiming existence and mass gap is treated as resolving the problem before independent theorem-body audit.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Every regulator, axiom, observable, nontriviality, limit, spectral, and group-quantifier obligation must be reconstructed and checked.
fixtures.witness: The governing Clay status remains open while recent manuscripts remain unverified in this programme.
fixtures.remediation: Perform a line-by-line source, dependency, normalization, and proof audit; retain NEEDS_AUDIT until independent review closes every WP00 obligation.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not prejudge whether any specific manuscript contains valuable partial results.

fixtures.name: Dimensionless lattice gap read directly as a physical mass
fixtures.invalid_inference: A nonzero eigenvalue separation measured in lattice units is already a nonzero continuum mass in fixed physical units.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The lattice spacing, scale-setting convention, renormalized trajectory, and limit of the dimensionful ratio are unspecified.
fixtures.witness: A dimensionless gap delta(a)>0 may satisfy delta(a)/a tending to zero, infinity, or no limit depending on scaling.
fixtures.remediation: Derive the physical normalization and prove a finite positive lower bound along the continuum trajectory.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not invalidate dimensionless lattice gaps as regulated quantities.

fixtures.name: Analytic strong-coupling expansion continued through an uncontrolled region
fixtures.invalid_inference: Because observables are analytic at strong coupling, the same expansion controls the continuum critical point.
fixtures.missing_obligation: No analytic continuation domain, singularity exclusion, uniform radius, or phase-structure theorem reaches the target trajectory.
fixtures.witness: An analytic function on one domain may have a singularity before a distant target point.
fixtures.remediation: Prove a continuation path with uniform estimates or construct an independent weak-coupling/RG bridge.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not weaken the proved strong-coupling analytic domain.

fixtures.name: Local stochastic quantization promoted to a global invariant gapped theory
fixtures.invalid_inference: Local well-posedness of a stochastic gauge equation constructs the global invariant continuum Yang-Mills measure and its physical mass gap.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Global non-explosion, invariant measure, gauge-orbit identification, OS axioms, reconstruction, and spectral gap are not supplied.
fixtures.witness: A locally well-posed stochastic evolution may blow up or fail to possess the required invariant measure.
fixtures.remediation: Prove global dynamics or an invariant measure, identify its gauge-invariant law, verify reconstruction axioms, and establish the physical spectral bridge.
fixtures.does_not_rule_out: This does not diminish local stochastic quantization theorems in their stated dimensions and models.
